test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Article 51 A of the Constitution of India deals with ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**fundamental duties.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **These **Fundamental Duties **are referred to in Article 51(A), which lists 11 Fundamental Duties that Citizens are obliged to carry out (there were 10 earlier and 11 later added by the 86th amendment).
 
• **42nd amendment -**
 
 
• ** **It was introduced as 42nd amendment in **1976 **based on the report of the **Swaran Singh Committee.**
 
 
 
• **Introduction of the bill -**
 
 
• H. R. Gokhale, then-Minister of Law, Justice, and Corporate Affairs, introduced the Constitution (Forty-Second Amendment) Bill, 1976 (**Bill No. 91 of 1976)** in the Lok Sabha on **September 1st.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The 11 fundamental rights are -

 
• We must uphold our Constitution and show respect for our **national anthem and flag.**
 
• Must adhere to the **principles **of the **freedom struggle.**
 
• Uphold our nation's **sovereignty **and **dignity**.
 
• **Defend **our **country **and, if required, offer national duties.
 
• There needs to be a spirit of **fraternity **among all people.
 
• Protect the **culture **of our **nation**.
 
• Preserving the **climate **of our nation.
 
• Provide **rationale **based on science for each **emotion**.
 
• To protect **government property**.
 
• Make an effort to be perfect.
 
• Between the ages of 6 and 14, it is the duty of every parent to **enrol their children in school**.
